seo.title: ABUJA - HOMELESS HELP - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified emergency, shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social-support contacts for people facing homelessness in Abuja.

page.heading: ABUJA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: If someone is in immediate danger, contact the local emergency services listed below. Conflict, weather and local conditions can disrupt services.
page.notice: Information, hours, eligibility and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Start with the most relevant service below and explain that you are in Abuja, whether you have a safe place tonight, and any medical, safety, disability or child-protection needs.
page.footer: Sources are linked in every entry. Services were described conservatively; no accommodation is presented as guaranteed unless the provider publishes it.

entries.title: Nigerian Red Cross Society
entries.description: Nigerian Red Cross Society provides or coordinates emergency help in or for Abuja. Contact the service directly to confirm eligibility, location and current availability.
entries.how_to_access: Call or use the official website before travelling. Ask specifically what help is available today and whether a referral or documents are required.

entries.title: Safe Haven Foundation
entries.description: Safe Haven Foundation provides or coordinates shelter and housing support in or for Abuja. Contact the service directly to confirm eligibility, location and current availability. Publishes a 14-day emergency shelter and pro-bono legal support for survivors of domestic violence. Call for assessment; a place is not guaranteed.
